name: availability-frontend
title: The public frontend is unavailable
description: The external frontend health check reported the service as unhealthy for five minutes.
investigation_steps: Check whether the frontend health-check endpoint responds, check the service itself for issues or degraded performance. Can you connect to it?
Check the frontend load balancer, and the ECS services health. Are the containers healthy? Could it be a network or connectivity issue?
If production users cannot access the frontend, raise an incident immediately and escalate.
